title: Certificate-Bound Access Tokens using Amazon API Gateway and Amazon Cognito
description: Implement certificate-bound access tokens for custom domain with API Gateway and Cognito user pools

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern creates an Amazon API Gateway REST API and enables mTLS for a custom domain.
Further, it creates a Cognito User Pool, which issues the certificate-bound access tokens.
The REST API makes use of an authorizer to compare the 'cnf' claim in the access token to the fingerprint of the client certificate sent as part of the mutual authentication TLS handshake

bullets.text: OAuth 2.0 Mutual-TLS Client Authentication and Certificate-Bound Access Tokens
